issues.label: Rule 90.3 primary physical custody finding
issues.why: The court must determine whether either parent had primary physical custody of the adult daughter to support a Rule 90.3 award.

issues.label: Custody where child lives in facility
issues.why: Whether a parent can have 'primary physical custody' when the child resided in an assisted living facility, not with either parent.

issues.label: Adequacy of custody findings
issues.why: Cline argues the court failed to make specific findings on which parent had custody before graduation.

issues.label: Past child support obligation calculation
issues.why: The court must correctly calculate past support through the daughter's high school graduation under Rule 90.3.

issues.label: Adopting Cline's income figure
issues.why: The court adopted Cline's proposed adjusted income of $109,249, and its correctness must be assessed.

issues.label: Authority for post-majority support
issues.why: Whether the court had legal authority to order ongoing support for an adult child with disabilities.

issues.label: Requirements for adult-disabled-child support
issues.why: Post-majority support for disabled adult children requires particular findings about dependency and inability to self-support.

issues.label: Reasonableness of monthly expense finding
issues.why: The court credited $1,280/month as reasonable and necessary, which must be supported by evidence.

issues.label: Even split of ongoing support
issues.why: Whether splitting the monthly cost 50/50 is proper given differing incomes and Rule 90.3 principles.

issues.label: Coordination with Social Security benefits
issues.why: The court tied support duration to Social Security benefits, raising benefit-offset and duration issues.

issues.label: Enforceability of urging future support
issues.why: The court's urging parties to support 'as long as able' may be unenforceable or advisory.

issues.label: Classification of $100,000 inheritance gift
issues.why: Whether the mother's inheritance gift is separate or marital property must be determined.

issues.label: Donative intent of the gift
issues.why: The mother testified she intended the gift only for her son, bearing on separate classification.

issues.label: Transmutation of separate property
issues.why: Depositing the $50,000 check into a shared account may have transmuted it into marital property.

issues.label: Forgiven loan on marital property
issues.why: Whether forgiving $50,000 of a loan on marital property makes that portion marital.

issues.label: Burden of proving separate property
issues.why: Cline bears the burden to prove the property was non-marital, which the court found unmet.

issues.label: Weight given to mother's testimony
issues.why: The court found the mother's testimony 'not informative,' a credibility determination subject to review.

issues.label: Merrill factors application
issues.why: The equitable division must properly consider and weigh all relevant Merrill factors.

issues.label: Earning capacity findings
issues.why: The 55/45 split rested on Cline's higher earning potential, requiring supported findings.

issues.label: Homemaker contribution weighting
issues.why: Duckett's homemaker role must be properly credited in the equitable division.

issues.label: Ramsey post-separation credit
issues.why: Whether Cline is entitled to credits for separate funds used to preserve marital property.

issues.label: Evidence supporting Ramsey credit
issues.why: The court found Cline failed to establish trial evidence supporting the $59,121.32 credit.

issues.label: Consistency with stipulated $61,690 reimbursement
issues.why: The prior stipulated repair reimbursement may overlap or conflict with the requested credits.

issues.label: Adequacy of written findings on credits
issues.why: Cline argues the court failed to make required written findings on his credit request.

issues.label: Allocation of capital gains tax liability
issues.why: The court must equitably divide the capital gains taxes from selling marital property.

issues.label: Tax division following estate split
issues.why: Whether allocating tax liability 55/45 to match the estate division is equitable and proper.

issues.label: Consideration of dissipated scam losses
issues.why: Cline's quarter-million-dollar loss to a scammer may implicate dissipation of marital assets.

issues.label: Trust proceeds division
issues.why: The court must properly divide the proceeds held in trust from previously sold properties.

issues.label: Standard of review on reconsideration
issues.why: The court must apply correct standards in denying the motion for reconsideration.
